name: Robert Wever
bio: Robert Wever (fl. c. 1550) was an English dramatist, known as the author of the interlude Lusty Juventus, printed about 1550.
This song, 'In Youth is Pleasure', comes from that interlude.

poems.title: In Youth is Pleasure
poems.author: Robert Wever
poems.collection: The Oxford Book of English Verse, ed. Quiller-Couch (1900)
poems.text:
In a harbour grene aslepe whereas I lay,
The byrdes sang swete in the middes of the day,
I dreamèd fast of mirth and play:
    In youth is pleasure, in youth is pleasure.

Methought I walked still to and fro,
And from her company I could not go--
But when I waked it was not so:
    In youth is pleasure, in youth is pleasure.

Therefore my hart is surely pyght
Of her alone to have a sight
Which is my joy and hartes delight:
    In youth is pleasure, in youth is pleasure.
